sayLines.line: 📖 LEARNED: Anatomy (Level 2). Pressure points: brachial, femoral, carotid. You can stop bleeding or drop someone with a thumb.
📖 LEARNED: Wound Care (Level 1). Clean it, close it, cover it. Pressure stops bleeding. Clean water is better than dirty hands.
📖 Your old life taught you things. 2 skills from your past — check your Journal.

You wake up with dirt in your mouth and blood on your hands that isn't yours. The sky is the wrong color — not sunset-wrong, wound-wrong. Jose Cabrera. Physical therapy aide. From Columbus, Ohio. That was yesterday. This is now. You have: Mixtape, Boot stone, Field suture kit, Photo album, Knife roll. That's everything you own in this world. Haven. Twelve people. The fire is lit. You heard it in the dark. Breathing. Not yours. It knew your name — it said it wrong, like it learned the shape of the sound but not what it meant.
📓 Journal: Food won't come to Haven. Walk past the treeline — learn what grows out there, bring it back, and get it named at camp.
